svg.title: Macrophages in cardiac fibrosis
svg.desc: An editable 16:9 vector synthesis of 41 macrophage/monocyte findings from both supplied Excel sheets and the matching CSV. Three panels show origins and dynamic states, clearance and cellular signaling, and context-dependent fibrosis and experimental repair. Thirty-two source entries are linked; index-only records do not supply findings. Origin and state are distinguished; pericardial studies with differing results remain separate.

The 41 records link to 32 indexed entries. Fifteen other index-only entries have no extracted finding and do not contribute inferred mechanisms.", "Original findings are AI-extracted; awaiting source review. The figure is a thematic synthesis with targeted primary-source checks, not a comprehensive re-extraction of all source papers.", "Origin, residence, replacement dynamics, anatomical compartment and activation state are distinct. CCR2/TIMD4/LYVE1 and resident-like expression describe context-specific populations, not immutable fate or universal function.", "Farbehi provides interstitial single-cell context; detailed replacement hierarchies are supported by Dick et al. fate mapping/parabiosis. Recruited monocytes can acquire resident-like expression without proving embryonic origin.", "Resident macrophages can support adaptive remodeling but can also express pathogenic programs under specific stress. NOX4-driven adrenergic stress activates resident CCR2-negative subsets; resident does not mean uniformly protective.", "The Kuppe human MI entry is mislabeled Reichart in the workbook. Its DOI and the spatial findings identify Spatial multi-omic map of human myocardial infarction.", "Li et al. is linked to the actual 2024 macrophage fibrogenic phenotype study. The supplied DOI identifies an unrelated hindlimb-ischemia letter. Their macrophage-to-FB negative fate-mapping result is model-specific; gene expression does not itself establish the functional role of every matricellular factor.", "SPP1/TREM2/CD36 expression and spatial proximity indicate phagocytic/fibrotic niches, not a proven universally protective or profibrotic lineage. A protective barrier is not asserted from transcription alone.", "TREM2/SLC25A53/itaconate and CD36/VEGFC are separate tested mechanisms. Legumain supports clearance and lysosomal degradation. Itaconate-mediated FB proliferation can support repair and is not equated with pathological fibrosis.", "VEGFC promotes lymphangiogenesis and directly modulates macrophage inflammation in Glinton et al. Vieira et al. support LYVE1-dependent immune-cell clearance toward mediastinal lymph nodes; LYVE1 positivity alone is not sufficient to distinguish macrophages from lymphatic ECs.", "Macrophage-intrinsic miR-21 regulates macrophage polarization and profibrotic secretome. cMP means cardiac macrophage; EV miR-21 transfer to fibroblasts is not established by Ramanujam et al.", "DNMT3A paper supports HB-EGF/EGFR signaling, beyond initial EGF-family computational predictions. The graphic does not claim a mandatory secondary ischemic insult based on a nonsignificant baseline comparison.", "Human CCR2–FB proximity and ligand-receptor predictions remain observational. Mouse IL1 receptor/ligand deletion and antibody interventions test causality. Amrute FAP/POSTN fibroblasts are not simply labeled ACTA2-positive myofibroblasts; the study distinguishes a matrifibrocyte-like branch.", "Alexanian et al., not Stratton et al., is the BRD4 study. Conditional effects concern infiltrating CX3CR1-positive macrophages and a BRD4/IL1B to fibroblast RELA/MEOX1 mechanism. CX3CR1 positivity is not proof of resident origin.", "Fibroblast SIPA1 is the causal source in the Sipa1 study; it acts through RasGRP2/Ras/JNK to produce CCL2/CCL7/GM-CSF and recruit/activate myeloid cells. It is not presented as a macrophage-intrinsic knockout effect.", "Pericardial evidence remains compartment-, model- and method-dependent: Deniset reported protection; Jin specific tracing/deletion and Hughes reported minimal deep entry or absent post-MI myocardial scar/function effects in their settings. A universal effect is not assigned.", "Human FN1-positive pericardial macrophage CST3 findings are kept separate from mouse GATA6 cavity lineage. Human CST3 evidence does not establish that the cells are the same GATA6 lineage.", "Treg treatment and eosinophil/IL4 effects are model-specific immune-context perturbations. A repair-associated transcriptional shift is not demonstrated conversion of monocyte-derived cells into an embryonic resident lineage.", "Adamo et al. support a B-cell-dependent component of pirfenidone cardioprotection without reduction in myeloid infiltration in the tested injury models; this is not treated as direct macrophage-targeted therapy.", "Hot/cold fibrosis refers to model-supported cell-circuit patterns. A common sequence of macrophage expansion followed by myofibroblast persistence is not universal across injury types."], "finding_coverage": {"origins-and-replacement": ["CF029-MAC-F01", "NI2019-MAC-F01", "NI2019-MAC-F02", "NM2018-MAC-F01"], "mi-state-continuum": ["CF037-MAC-F01", "CF046-MAC-F01", "CF046-MAC-F02", "CF049-MAC-F01"], "human-niches-and-cell-circuits": ["NAT2022-MAC-F01", "CF037-MAC-F01", "BRC2021-MAC-F01", "NAT2024-MAC-F01", "NM2018-MAC-F01"], "efferocytosis-and-repair-programs": ["CF043-MAC-F01", "CF043-MAC-F02", "CF078-MAC-F01", "CF078-MAC-F02", "CIRC2022-LEG-F01"], "inflammatory-fibroblast-feedback": ["CF038-MAC-F01", "CF041-MAC-F01", "CF050-MAC-F01", "CF051-MAC-F02", "CF069-MAC-F01", "CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F01", "CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F02", "NAT2024-MAC-F01", "NAT2024-BRD4-F01"], "vessels-drainage-and-mechanosensing": ["IMM2021-MAC-F01", "IMM2021-MAC-F02", "CF051-MAC-F01", "CF078-MAC-F01", "CF078-MAC-F02", "CF079-MAC-F01", "NI2019-MAC-F02"], "matrix-regulation-without-fibroblast-conversion": ["YJMCC2024-MAC-F01", "YJMCC2024-MAC-F02", "CVR2021-REV-F01", "NIHMS1993103-REV-F01"], "immune-context-and-cell-therapy": ["CF080-MAC-F01", "CF083-MAC-F01", "CF083-MAC-F02", "CIRC2022-MAC-F01", "JCI2018-B-F01"], "pericardial-compartment-and-evidence": ["CF042-MAC-F01", "CF044-MAC-F01", "IMM2019-MAC-F01", "CIRCRES2022-GPCM-F01"], "experimental-repair-routes": ["CF038-MAC-F01", "CF043-MAC-F01", "CF043-MAC-F02", "CF078-MAC-F02", "CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F01", "CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F02", "NAT2024-MAC-F01", "NAT2024-BRD4-F01"]}}
svg.text: Origins, clearance programs and cellular signals that connect inflammation to scar repair and persistent fibrosis

g.title:
Mouse fate maps and parabiosis distinguish a self-renewing TIMD4/LYVE1/CCR2-negative resident pool from monocyte-replenished subsets. Other CCR2-negative cells exchange to different degrees. Injury-recruited cells can acquire resident-like expression. Human CCR2 subsets have different niches and replacement characteristics. Markers alone do not establish origin or function.
Original extraction IDs: CF029-MAC-F01, NI2019-MAC-F01, NI2019-MAC-F02, NM2018-MAC-F01. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.
g.desc: Mouse fate maps and parabiosis distinguish a self-renewing TIMD4/LYVE1/CCR2-negative resident pool from monocyte-replenished subsets. Other CCR2-negative cells exchange to different degrees. Injury-recruited cells can acquire resident-like expression. Human CCR2 subsets have different niches and replacement characteristics. Markers alone do not establish origin or function.
g.text: Origins and activation states are separate
Self-maintaining residents
Recruited monocyte-derived
TIMD4+ / LYVE1+ / CCR2−
Ly6Chi monocytes → macrophages
Local renewal in mouse fate maps
CCR2-dependent influx after injury
Other CCR2− subsets show partial monocyte replacement.
Resident-like expression does not prove resident origin.

g.title:
Inflammatory ISG15-high and MHCII/IL1B states coexist with monocyte-derived TREM2-high populations. Rizzo identifies a sequential TREM2/SPP1 intermediate to TREM2/GDF15 state in ischemic myocardium and efferocytosis-induced features in vitro. Spatial enrichment is not by itself proof of a protective barrier. Macrophage expansion can precede myofibroblast persistence.
Original extraction IDs: CF037-MAC-F01, CF046-MAC-F01, CF046-MAC-F02, CF049-MAC-F01. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.

Inflammatory states: ISG15hi and MHCII+ / IL1B+.
Monocytes
TREM2hi / SPP1hi
TREM2hi / GDF15hi
Intermediate
Differentiated
Efferocytosis promotes features of the TREM2hi signature.
States enrich in ischemic / border regions.

g.title:
Human studies identify viable-myocardial CCR2-negative niches and scar-enriched CCR2-positive populations; SPP1/TREM2/CD36 phagocytic cells and activated fibroblast neighborhoods are spatially associated. CXCL8/HLA-DR myeloid interactions with DARC ECs are inferred. Acute-MI cold and chronic-stress hot circuits are model-dependent, not a universal diagnostic division.
Original extraction IDs: NAT2022-MAC-F01, CF037-MAC-F01, BRC2021-MAC-F01, NAT2024-MAC-F01, NM2018-MAC-F01. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.

CXCL8/HLA-DR myeloid interactions with DARC ECs are inferred. Acute-MI cold and chronic-stress hot circuits are model-dependent, not a universal diagnostic division.
g.text: Human niches and persistent cell circuits
CCR2− cells: viable myocardium / vascular niches.
CCR2+ cells: scar enrichment; stronger inflammatory responses.
SPP1 / TREM2 / CD36 cells: phagocytic, scar-associated states.
CXCL8hi / HLA-DRhi ↔ DARC+ ECs: inferred cross-talk.
CCR2+ macrophages neighbor FAP / POSTN+ fibroblasts.

MI: macrophages wane,
myofibroblasts persist.

g.title:
Legumain supports apoptotic cardiomyocyte clearance and lysosomal degradation. TREM2/SYK/SMAD4 reduces SLC25A53 and alters mitochondrial NAD transport, increasing itaconate; metabolite interventions reduce CM apoptosis and support reparative FB proliferation. CD36-dependent efferocytosis induces VEGFC, supporting lymphangiogenesis and reducing macrophage inflammatory activity. These are distinct experimental mechanisms.
Original extraction IDs: CF043-MAC-F01, CF043-MAC-F02, CF078-MAC-F01, CF078-MAC-F02, CIRC2022-LEG-F01. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.
g.desc: Legumain supports apoptotic cardiomyocyte clearance and lysosomal degradation. TREM2/SYK/SMAD4 reduces SLC25A53 and alters mitochondrial NAD transport, increasing itaconate; metabolite interventions reduce CM apoptosis and support reparative FB proliferation. g.text: Clearance of dying cells programs repair
Efferocytosis
Legumain → clearance / degradation of dying CMs.
TREM2 → SYK–SMAD4 → SLC25A53 ↓ → itaconate ↑.
Itaconate: CM apoptosis ↓; reparative FB proliferation ↑.
CD36-dependent cell uptake → VEGFC production.
VEGFC: lymphangiogenesis ↑; inflammatory cytokines ↓.
Mouse perturbations + cell rescue assays

g.title:
BRD4 in infiltrating CX3CR1 cells regulates IL1B and fibroblast RELA/MEOX1 signaling; human CCR2/FB niches and mouse IL1 interventions support a separate FAP/POSTN branch. CCL24/CCR3 and DNMT3A/HB-EGF/EGFR are additional axes. Macrophage-intrinsic miR21 controls profibrotic secretome, without demonstrated EV transfer. Fibroblast SIPA1 drives CCL2/CCL7/GMCSF-dependent myeloid accumulation. CM NOX4 can activate resident CCR2-negative subsets under adrenergic stress.
Original extraction IDs: CF038-MAC-F01, CF041-MAC-F01, CF050-MAC-F01, CF051-MAC-F02, CF069-MAC-F01, CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F01, CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F02, NAT2024-MAC-F01, NAT2024-BRD4-F01. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.
g.desc: BRD4 in infiltrating CX3CR1 cells regulates IL1B and fibroblast RELA/MEOX1 signaling; human CCR2/FB niches and mouse IL1 interventions support a separate FAP/POSTN branch. CCL24/CCR3 and DNMT3A/HB-EGF/EGFR are additional axes. Macrophage-intrinsic miR21 controls profibrotic secretome, without demonstrated EV transfer. Fibroblast SIPA1 drives CCL2/CCL7/GMCSF-dependent myeloid accumulation. CM NOX4 can activate resident CCR2-negative subsets under adrenergic stress.
g.text: Reciprocal signals can sustain inflammation
Infiltrating CX3CR1+ cells: BRD4 → IL-1β production.
FB IL-1R responses include RELA / MEOX1 or FAP / POSTN programs.
CCL24 → FB CCR3 → PI3K / AKT → TGF-β release.
DNMT3A-deficient myeloid cells: HB-EGF → FB EGFR.
Macrophage miR-21 controls a profibrotic secretome.
FB SIPA1 → CCL2 / CCL7 / GM-CSF → myeloid recruitment.
CM NOX4 stress can activate resident CCR2− subsets.
Distinct axes across cell, mouse and human studies

g.title:
CCR2-negative macrophages sense CM stretch through focal adhesions/TRPV4 and support adaptive coronary growth in DCM. Resident depletion worsens remodeling in tested MI/TAC settings. VEGFC supports lymphangiogenesis; LYVE1-dependent immune drainage to mediastinal nodes contributes to inflammation resolution. These findings do not imply that every resident macrophage is protective.
Original extraction IDs: IMM2021-MAC-F01, IMM2021-MAC-F02, CF051-MAC-F01, CF078-MAC-F01, CF078-MAC-F02, CF079-MAC-F01, NI2019-MAC-F02. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.
g.desc: CCR2-negative macrophages sense CM stretch through focal adhesions/TRPV4 and support adaptive coronary growth in DCM. Resident depletion worsens remodeling in tested MI/TAC settings. VEGFC supports lymphangiogenesis; LYVE1-dependent immune drainage to mediastinal nodes contributes to inflammation resolution. These findings do not imply that every resident macrophage is protective.
g.text: Macrophages support vessels and drainage
CM stretch → resident-macrophage TRPV4 → growth factors.
Supports coronary growth and adaptive DCM remodeling.
VEGFC expands lymphatics and supports LYVE1-dependent
immune-cell clearance to mediastinal lymph nodes.
Resident depletion worsens remodeling in tested MI / TAC models.

g.title:
Macrophages express fibrogenic growth factors and matricellular proteins, shaping repair and matrix remodeling. Li et al. detect no substantial macrophage-to-fibroblast contribution in their MI fate map; macrophage matrix gene expression does not establish structural collagen production or fibroblast identity. Signaling functions and fate are separated.
Original extraction IDs: YJMCC2024-MAC-F01, YJMCC2024-MAC-F02, CVR2021-REV-F01, NIHMS1993103-REV-F01. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.

g.title:
Treg IL10/nidogen1 supports repair-associated myeloid states; myeloid/DC CCL17 limits protective Treg recruitment. Eosinophils and IL4 influence macrophage repair and collagen maturation in mouse MI, with rescue depending on eosinophil deficiency. Adamo pirfenidone benefits include a B-cell-dependent mechanism without reduced myeloid infiltration. Repair-associated transcription is not a change of developmental lineage.
Original extraction IDs: CF080-MAC-F01, CF083-MAC-F01, CF083-MAC-F02, CIRC2022-MAC-F01, JCI2018-B-F01. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.
g.desc: Treg IL10/nidogen1 supports repair-associated myeloid states; myeloid/DC CCL17 limits protective Treg recruitment. Eosinophils and IL4 influence macrophage repair and collagen maturation in mouse MI, with rescue depending on eosinophil deficiency. Adamo pirfenidone benefits include a B-cell-dependent mechanism without reduced myeloid infiltration. Repair-associated transcription is not a change of developmental lineage.
g.text: Other immune cells reshape the response
Treg IL-10 / nidogen-1 favors pro-repair myeloid states.
Myeloid CCL17 limits protective Treg recruitment.
Eosinophils / IL-4 support macrophage-mediated repair.
Pirfenidone protection can be B-cell-dependent
without reducing myeloid influx in the tested models.

g.title:
Pericardial cavity macrophages differ from myocardial macrophages and BMDMs. Deniset reported protection in injury models; specific GATA6 lineage/depletion by Jin and later Hughes found little myocardial entry or no MI scar/function benefit in their settings. Human FN1-positive pericardial macrophage CST3 suppression of fibroblast contraction is a distinct result, not proof of the same GATA6 lineage.
Original extraction IDs: CF042-MAC-F01, CF044-MAC-F01, IMM2019-MAC-F01, CIRCRES2022-GPCM-F01. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.

g.text: Pericardial effects require context
GATA6+ cavity macrophages (mouse)
Protection reported in earlier injury models.
Specific tracing / depletion: little deep myocardial entry,
and no MI scar / function benefit in later studies.

g.data-finding-ids: CF038-MAC-F01 CF043-MAC-F01 CF043-MAC-F02 CF078-MAC-F02 CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F01 CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F02 NAT2024-MAC-F01 NAT2024-BRD4-F01
g.title:
In cell and mouse experiments, IL1/BRD4 modulation lowers fibroblast activation; CCL24/CCR3 blockade or fibroblast SIPA1 deletion reduces adverse signaling/remodeling; TREM2/itaconate and VEGFC interventions enhance repair in their stated models. Selective modulation depends on state, tissue compartment and injury timing. These are not an established combined clinical regimen.
Original extraction IDs: CF038-MAC-F01, CF043-MAC-F01, CF043-MAC-F02, CF078-MAC-F02, CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F01, CIRCRES2025-SIPA-F02, NAT2024-MAC-F01, NAT2024-BRD4-F01. Original unreviewed claims and correction notes are preserved in SVG metadata.
g.desc: In cell and mouse experiments, IL1/BRD4 modulation lowers fibroblast activation; CCL24/CCR3 blockade or fibroblast SIPA1 deletion reduces adverse signaling/remodeling; TREM2/itaconate and VEGFC interventions enhance repair in their stated models. svg.text: Macrophages guide repair or sustain fibrosis through state-dependent signals, clearance and tissue niches.
Sources: both Excel sheets + matching CSV; 41 records from 32 linked entries. Fifteen index-only entries contain no extracted finding.
Evidence spans human observations, inference, fate mapping and interventions. State markers alone do not establish lineage or causality.
Original extraction awaits full source review; selected corrections applied. FB: fibroblast; CM: cardiomyocyte; EC: endothelial cell; MI: infarction; TAC: pressure overload.
